run_timeit_decorator: use the timeit decorator to measure function execution time with configurable iterations and warmup
run_benchmark_function: run the benchmark function to time a callable across multiple argument sets and print results
test_timeit_with_warmup: test the timeit decorator with warmup iterations to account for cache and autotuning effects
test_benchmark_with_kwargs: test the benchmark function with a list of kwargs dicts to compare performance across inputs
summarize_timeit_statistics: summarize the timeit decorator output which returns mean, median, min, max, and stddev timing stats
